title: Create a user without premature validation errors
steps: View the loaded Display settings page with the Origine theme selected.
Click Manage users in the admin navigation to reach the reauthentication prompt.
Enter the admin password and click Login to view Create new user without touching any of its fields.

video_guide.summary: Open Create new user through reauthentication and inspect the empty Username field before editing it.

chapters.note: Display settings is open with the Origine theme selected.
The page displays Reauthentication is required with a Password field and Login button.

chapters.label: Enter the administrator password and select Login

chapters.note: Create new user is open; the empty Username field has a red border.
Username is still empty and outlined in red.
